snippet.title: Grablings: Paint 'n Seek 🎨 | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In the Grablings' first adventure, Paint 'n Seek, play silly games of hide and seek. Hiders paint themselves into wacky environments to avoid getting found, and the seeker(s) aim to win by finding all hidden Grablings!

AVAILABLE LATER THIS SUMMER!

PLAY NOW FOR FREE!
🎨 https://www.meta.com/experiences/grablings/1965055500873307

JOIN OUR DISCORD!
🎨 https://discord.gg/xpUmRQh3ZE

FOLLOW OUR SOCIAL CHANNELS!
🎨 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GrablingsGame
🎨 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/grablingsgame
🎨 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@grablings
🎨 Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/grablings.bsky.social
🎨 Twitter: https://x.com/GrablingsGame
🎨 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1ETsfhpwBC

WHAT ARE GRABLINGS?
Grablings are interdimensional creatures who live for mischief and chaos. Their prime purpose in life is to have fun and wreak havoc across the multiverse, which they consider their ultimate playground.

ADVENTURES TO COME!
Paint 'n Seek is not the only adventure the Grablings want to go on. There is a whole wide multiverse at their grabby little fingertips, waiting to be explored.
